scope: Portable continuation of the reviewed foundation and north-star catalog. This is a research queue over retained evidence, not an unattended runner or a new-host acceptance receipt.

saturation.meaning: A finite candidate set can be exhausted for a frozen requirement and date. This does not establish universal superiority or permanently exhaust an evolving field.
close_only_when: Every required layer has a selected choice, named alternatives and recoverable primary evidence.
The frozen candidate/source set is recorded, including failed access and explicit omitted/out-of-scope reasons.
Required representative comparisons and target-host lifecycle checks meet preregistered acceptance; missing evidence remains open.
A second independent review identifies no unresolved material gap in that bounded set.
A dated closure record lists residual risks, untested boundaries and exact reopening triggers.
reopen_on: Changed task, dataset, hardware, platform or deployment requirement
A maintained challenger with a demonstrated missing capability
A retained failure, incompatible release or materially changed source/license
A fresh representative comparison overturns a selection
